description: Resolve the exact current release for one (app, channel, runtimeVersion) lane. Returns null rather than selecting another lane.

appId.description: OtaKit app ID. Optional on a local connection whose project configures one; required otherwise.

channel.description: Named channel, or null for the base channel

runtimeVersion.description: Native runtime lane, or null for the default runtime

name: get_release_state
title: Get current OtaKit release state
